Internal HTTP helpers

txs-http.Rd

Thin wrappers around httr2 that enforce:

  • a clear, package-identifying User-Agent,

  • per-host throttling (configurable via options("txschools.rate_per_sec")),

  • retries with exponential back-off on transient errors,

  • configurable timeout (options("txschools.timeout")),

  • a robots.txt check before each request.

The method is left implicit (curl's POST-with-body), never set with httr2::req_method(): a 302 answer to the post must be followed as a GET, which an explicit method would carry over to the redirect.

method = "post" sends params as a URL-encoded form body (used for TEA's SAS broker and AEIS CGI endpoints); method = "get" appends params to the query string. params may also be a single pre-encoded query string like "sumlev=C&setpick=REF".

Usage

http_request(url, timeout = NULL, max_tries = NULL, cookies = NULL)

http_get(url, timeout = NULL, max_tries = NULL, cookies = NULL)

http_post_form(url, params, timeout = NULL, max_tries = NULL, cookies = NULL)

http_download(
  url,
  dest,
  timeout = NULL,
  max_tries = NULL,
  method = c("get", "post"),
  params = NULL
)
